text:
New direction from my director: instead of running, Sora should GLIDE across the screen low to the ground (like a fast hovering dash/skim a few centimetres above the floor, not a run and not a high air glide).




Please generate an image: a clean sprite-style concept sheet of Sora doing this low ground glide, facing screen right, on a plain white background, in the same 2D cel style and KH2 outfit as the attached sprites (image 1 is his approved battle idle, image 2 is his current run in this style).




Show the full move as separate poses in a grid, in order:

1-2. Launch out of the battle idle (the left hand lets go of the Keyblade, he dips and pushes off).

3-6. The glide loop: body low and stretched forward, close to the floor, feet off the ground (trailing behind him or tucked), a sense of speed (light wind lines or a small dust trail along the floor are fine), Keyblade held in his RIGHT hand only, low and trailing behind him pointing back toward screen left; left arm free.

7-8. Landing/brake back into the battle idle (feet touch down, he skids to a stop, both hands back on the Keyblade).




Keep his proportions, outfit and the Kingdom Key consistent across every pose, the same size in every cell, no text or labels.
